content.title: Danny Kendrick Park East Playground
content.summary: The new playground at Danny Kendrick Park East in Arvada officially opened to the public in January 2026, following its construction that began in July 2025. The playground features inclusive play equipment and nature-inspired elements, having been relocated due to a sanitary sewer line replacement project that necessitated the demolition of the old playground in spring 2024. Community input was gathered through a survey conducted in summer 2023 to inform the design of the new playground.

## Project update - Jan. 30, 2026

The new playground at Danny Kendrick Park East is now open! Thank you to everyone for your understanding and patience. We hope you enjoy the new playground!

## Project background

Danny Kendrick Park East is [located at 11960 West 70th Way](https://maps.app.goo.gl/2wvuhdfm5qB6fc4TA) along Ralston Creek in central Arvada. The old playground needed to be relocated as part of the City's sanitary sewer line replacement project.

The old playground was demolished in the spring of 2024 during the sewer line construction. The new playground was built northwest of its previous location to prevent any conflicts with the underground utilities.

Construction on the new playground began in July of 2025. The playground opened to the public in January 2026.

### New playground and park improvement elements

- Inclusive spinner, play bouncer and double bobble rider — bringing kids of all abilities together
- Telluride traverse boulders with ladder bridge and ramp nets
- Embankment slide and hill climber grips that connect the terraced play areas
- Log crawl, mushroom steppers, painted turtle sculpture, and tracing panels
- Poured-in-place safety surfacing
- Bike racks and a variety of seating options that view into the park

## Project Timeline:

- Summer 2023: Survey period for playground themes and equipment.
- Fall 2023: The City’s Parks and Urban Design team, in collaboration with a selected consultant, reviewed the results of the survey and incorporated that feedback into the final design.
- Spring 2024: Existing playground closed for demolition.
- Summer 2025: Construction on the new playground anticipated to start.
- Winter 2026: Construction completed and playground open to the public.

Please keep in mind this is an estimated timeline that is subject to change and weather delays.

## Community Engagement for New Playground

The playground project began with a community survey in the summer of 2023 where community members could provide their preferences for playground themes and equipment. The survey was open through Tuesday, Aug. 29, 2023.

The City's Parks and Urban design team reviewed the results of the survey and hired a consultant to create design options for the new playground. Using feedback from the community survey, the design team then decided on the final design for the new playground.
